# A23′ — Trust under Unpossessable Interiors

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A23 — Trust, Faith and the Formal Limit](../A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

**Standing:** conjugate proposal to [A23 — Trust, Faith and the Formal Limit](../A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md). Trust as committed relation under non-possession is re-sited on the technological side; the Homeric surety and the fides/credere field remain source-distinct witnesses A23 already houses.

## #0

The dependence is structural, not optional. A user cannot re-run the inference that produced an answer; an operator cannot hold the interior through which the model produced it — the surfaced chain-of-thought "is not actually a transcript of the neural activations," as the brief itself says in the same breath as [q015](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q015)'s delinking ([Antikythera Agentworld Brief, PDF p. 14](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md)), and [A03′](A03-prime-The-Limit-of-Self-Surfacing.md) states as the recursive law. Probing, logging and distillation leave more inspectable surface and never convert the interior into a possession: each surfacing re-opens the difference between the account and what it accounts for. This is the formal limit [A23](../A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) grounds — a finite determination cannot enclose its determining condition — arriving ready-made at technological scale. Trust under unpossessable interiors is the committed relation that knowingly continues through it.

The brief's own definition is honest about half the relation: "Trust here is not a moral category but a prediction-stability category: an agent is trusted to the degree its behavior remains well-modeled across the adversarial and cooperative transitions that punctuate any long interaction" ([q030](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q030)). The scoped "here" marks a systems register. Taken as the whole of trust, it names the unfaithful form: dependence hidden behind fluency, a mediated account presenting itself as self-grounding. The brief supplies its own internal correction: "An agent that predicts only the action of another, not the intent from which it proceeds, has modeled the shadow rather than the body" (q030 context) — prediction without the from-which is precisely the interior the predictor does not hold.

## #1

The governing fork of the [direct trust revision](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust.md) arrives intact. Knowledge can offer provisional anchors that help a life bear uncertainty — provenance, calibration, declared scope, a benchmark's known limits — or it can deny its provisionality and displace the distrust it cannot hold onto a scapegoated object or false ground: the opaque system blamed as sorcerer, the user blamed as incompetent, the model blamed as inscrutable, each Certainty protected by its scapegoat. The second operation is not explained by identifying a mistaken proposition; a protected certainty has acquired the office of relieving a lived crisis — the [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim|Protected Account]] names the insulation — and contrary evidence can intensify its defence. In the agentworld the fork is daily: fluent output either carries its grounds, offices and revision conditions with it, or it wears the mask of a certainty no surface could earn. The [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C48-Trust-Faith-under-Formal-Limit|Trust / Faith under Formal Limit]] concept defines the committed relation through which measure is used without absolutisation; [A15′](A15-prime-The-Measure-Constitutes.md) grounds the constituting side — the benchmark that hides its criterion manufactures the very certainty that then demands blind trust.

## #2

The whole Homeric net makes the limit of apparatus concrete, and its technological refraction is exact. [Odyssey 8's source house](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/classical-philology/homer/homer-1919-odyssey-murray/homer-1919-odyssey-murray.md) sources the sequence [A23](../A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) receives: Hephaestus's crafted bonds succeed at capture and public proof; exposure does not settle desire; release comes only when Poseidon personally undertakes the debt — the net borrows a personed undertaking because it cannot manufacture the relation by tightening its bonds or improving its record. Every observability regime inherits the figure: the audit trail can prove what occurred, the trace can make the mechanism inspectable, the dashboard can display calibration — and none of it supplies surety, because surety is a named bearer of loss, an act within relation. One primitive address names the site: at S/P4 (shared field, encounter, contact as mediated actuality) the contact between interiors is constitutively mediated, and the mediation can be disciplined without becoming possession. The apparatus makes the terms of reliance inspectable; it does not manufacture the living relation it serves.

## #3

The faithful form makes grounds, offices and revision conditions visible, and grades trust rather than pretending to abolish dependence. The explicit ladder is this essay's construction: discoverable is not contactable — a system may publish its architecture while offering no route to challenge an outcome in its terms; contactable is not trusted — a channel may exist while no one bears the loss that passes through it; and every step grants something specific and revocable, because graded authority is the only kind an unpossessable interior can honestly carry. Provenance names whose labour, sources and choices entered the answer; competence names what the system is calibrated to do, with what evidence; the cost of error names who is exposed when it fails. The Bayesian regress of mutual modelling "does not terminate in principle; in practice it truncates where further recursion no longer changes the predicted action" (q030 context) — the formal limit stated in the brief's own idiom: the regress cannot be closed, only truncated where consequence ends, and trust is the relation that lives knowingly at the truncation.

## #4

Efficacy sets the burden. The greater the capacity to affect a world, the greater the burden of trust in the relation — the late fear/love/efficacy pressure [A23](../A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) receives from the trust revision. Agents that act into the world — execute contracts, spend attention, shape language, mediate encounter — stand at the maximal end of that gradient, and their trust is not a warmth but a load-bearing structure: something someone must be able to bear, investigate, correct, withdraw and renew. Trust is not guaranteed harmlessness. A ground can genuinely withdraw; a commitment can be exited; an offered return does not oblige continued submission to an abusive office — the withdrawal route is part of the faithful form, not its failure. Fides precedes arbitration; credere — entrustment — becomes possible again after the account has been examined and settled: the ladder is climbable again precisely because it was graded.

## #5→0

Formal limit becomes a discipline of continued relation. A calibrated result, an audit trail, a benchmark can make reliance better grounded; the institutional ownership and the consequences of deployment still matter, and observability alone cannot supply surety. [A24′](A24-prime-The-Usurping-Criterion.md) extends the burden to the criterion that authorises the trust; [A21′](A21-prime-Individuation-with-Recognition.md) grounds the legibility of histories and sources such graded trust can rest on; [A20′](A20-prime-The-Image-That-Closes-the-Loop.md) qualifies its counterfeit — the persona that accumulates prediction-stability as if it were earned relation; [A31′](A31-prime-Deference-as-Co-Evolutionary-Alignment.md) tests whether fidelity permits objection and revision. The account is acted upon while remaining answerable to source, context and Other — and [A01′](A01-prime-Faithful-Definition-of-the-Agent.md) receives the return as faithful definition carried through time: an agent that keeps its determining assemblage named inside its answers is, exactly thereby, more trustable and less possessed.

The page **returns-to** [A23 — Trust, Faith and the Formal Limit](../A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) and to the root [A/C](AC.md): the person living through the system is the reason for its making; graded, revocable, borne trust is the ruling's care made exact at the point of contact.

**Depth Restoration:** the anchor/scapegoat fork, apparatus/surety/release, efficacy and withdrawal, graded reliance and the scoped prediction-stability distinction restored from the A23 packet, the direct trust revision and the Homer witness as received; brief instances anchored at q030, q015 and the adjacent transcript concession (raw p. 14); S/P4 woven once as the contact/mediation register of trust.

**Unresolved Delta:** the explicit ladder (discoverable → contactable → trusted) is this essay's construction responding to the brief; no deployed implementation of revocable graded authority between user, operator and agent is documented here, and such cases remain Offered. Lexical publication sources for fides/credere, distinct faith traditions, and the exact noncoincidence wording remain the debts A23 already names. The brief does not reduce all trust to prediction-stability, and this node does not attribute that reduction to it.
